chunks: Then do not, O Lord, put me among the sinners.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'La taj'alni fi al-qawm al-zalimin' mean in Islamic supplications?
ai.summary: This verse, part of the supplication of Prophet Yaqub (Jacob) in Surah Al-Mu'minun, is deeply cherished in Shia tradition as a model for seeking protection from the 'Zalimin' (those who transgress by associating partners with God or acting unjustly). It highlights the spiritual anxiety of the righteous who, despite their faith, fear being grouped with the unjust due to negligence or hidden sins, thus emphasizing the need for continuous divine mercy.
